name: Bulk export of reports
summary: Customers want to export many reports at once instead of one by one.

requirement.problem: Users who manage many projects spend a lot of time exporting reports individually, which blocks month-end reporting.
goals: Export up to 100 reports in a single action
Notify the user when a large export is ready
acceptanceCriteria: User can multi-select reports from the reports list
Export runs in the background and does not block the UI
User receives an email with a download link valid for 7 days
openQuestions: Should exports respect per-report permissions or the exporting user's role?

name: Single sign-on
summary: Enterprise prospects require SAML/OIDC login before signing.

requirement.problem: Enterprise customers cannot onboard without SSO, which blocks several deals in the pipeline.
goals: Support SAML 2.0 and OIDC identity providers
Allow admins to enforce SSO for their workspace
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can configure an IdP from workspace settings
Users from an SSO-enforced workspace cannot log in with a password
openQuestions: Do we need SCIM provisioning in the first version?

name: Mobile push notifications
summary: Field users miss updates because notifications only arrive by email.

requirement.problem: Users working away from a desk see important updates hours late.
goals: Deliver push notifications for mentions and assignments
acceptanceCriteria: User can opt in and out of push notifications per category
openQuestions: Is a quiet-hours setting needed for v1?

name: Audit log
summary: Admins need a record of who changed what and when.

requirement.problem: Compliance reviews require evidence of changes to permissions and settings.
goals: Make the log searchable and exportable
acceptanceCriteria: Every permission change produces an audit entry with actor, target and timestamp
Admins can filter the log by user and date range
